meta.description: Safety layer: PAR-Q questions, disclaimer, red-flag detection, readiness screening.
notes: detectRedFlags keyword regexes are case-insensitive with \b word boundaries; at most one stop keyword flag, and keyword warnings are only checked when there is no stop flag.
Flag order: keyword, health (healthFlags), health (medicalClearance === false), load (ACWR very_high), load (tsb < -30).
screenReadiness clears only a COMPLETE answer list (length === PARQ_QUESTIONS.length) of all "no"; a wrong-length list appends the "incomplete screening" health flag.
